subject: Quick question about the final deadline
text: Hey, I hope you've had a less frantic Tuesday than I did. A slightly awkward thing has come up: the print shop told me the volunteer posters will be two hours late, and a few neighbors were expecting to hang them before the community meeting. I don't want anyone to scramble or feel rushed, so I wanted to ask whether the deadline for posting the updated schedule is genuinely end of day, or whether it mainly refers to sending the file to the project board. I know you mentioned the venue staff need it early for the evening setup, but I'm not sure if the printed materials have to be up by the same moment. If there's any wiggle room, even a short grace period, please say so and I'll tell the group to relax a little. Also, if you would prefer us to switch to a digital link today and print later, that's totally workable. Just want to follow what works best rather than guessing. If there's anything I can help chase down, let me know before noon.
